position: Steep Trendelenburg 28°, Lithotomy in Allen Yellowfin Stirrups
prep: ChloraPrep from nipples to mid-thighs, perineum prepped with Betadine
instrumentation: da Vinci Xi Robotic Patient Cart
sutures: 3-0 V-Loc barbed suture on V-20 needle for urethrovesical anastomosis
2-0 Vicryl CT-1 for dorsal venous complex
notes: Ensure patient is securely strapped with Da Vinci Pink Pad table mat to prevent sliding in steep Trendelenburg. Anesthesia must monitor peak inspiratory pressures.

position: Prone on Wilson Frame, abdomen hanging free to reduce epidural venous engorgement
prep: ChloraPrep spine area from T10 to sacrum
notes: Microscope draped sterile before incision. Keep Bipolar micro-forceps tip cleaned with wet telfa sponge. Bone wax and Gelfoam patties counted.
